Photo/fallback share104px band; photo visibility based HasImage, not BitmapImage download success. Failed image may cover fallback depending image transparency, native behavior unobserved.
Uses product-tile starting price, name wraps3lines, variant badge only for >1 variants. Station label reports actual VM routing; not evidence printer is reachable.

Offer button uses Tapped event rather than ICommand, expected code-behind handles event to stop parent base-product click. Native keyboard Invoke/Space may raise Click without Tapped: keyboard accessibility remains unverified and no Command/Click exists here.
Offer name star column wraps while fixed-price auto column retains amount; hardcoded green pill/light white card rather than theme-aware colors.
Error shows wrapped text and explicit real-menu retry; no fabricated fallback rows. HasNoResults text appears independently and must be mutually coherent with VM load/error states.
